'''''Indiana Jones and the Great Circle''''' is a 2024 [[action-adventure video game]] developed by [[MachineGames]] and published by [[Bethesda Softworks]]. It is based on the ''[[Indiana Jones]]'' franchise and features an original narrative set between the events of ''[[Raiders of the Lost Ark]]'' (1981) and ''[[Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade]]'' (1989). The story follows archaeologist [[Indiana Jones (character)|Indiana Jones]] in 1937 as he attempts to thwart various groups who are seeking to harness a power connected to the Great Circle, a group of mysterious sites around the world that form [[Great circle|a perfect circle]] on a map. The game is primarily [[First-person (video games)|first-person]], with [[Third-person (video games)|third-person]] being employed for [[cutscene]]s and contextual elements such as environmental interaction. The player controls Jones as he navigates through a mix of linear, story-sensitive areas and wider, exploratory landscapes in locations such as [[Vatican City]], the [[Giza pyramid complex]], and [[Sukhothai (city)|Sukhothai]].

[[Todd Howard]] conceived the game's story and served as an executive producer, considering the game a passion project of his. MachineGames was chosen to lead the project because of their experience creating the modern ''[[Wolfenstein]]'' games, which also involved [[Nazi Germany|Nazis]] and [[Axis powers|Axis allies]] as central antagonists. Development of the game lasted for more than five years.  It was designed to be an "[[adventure video game|adventure-first]]" video game, and the team was particularly inspired by ''[[Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis]]'' (1992). Its gameplay structure was inspired by ''[[Metro Exodus]]'' (2019), and its level design was inspired by [[immersive sim]]s. [[Troy Baker]] provides the voice and motion capture of Indiana Jones, and [[Alessandra Mastronardi]], [[Marios Gavrilis]] and [[Tony Todd]] are featured in supporting roles. [[Gordy Haab]] served as the game's composer, and its original score were recorded at [[Abbey Road Studios]].

Bethesda and MachineGames jointly announced the game's development in January 2021, in collaboration with [[Lucasfilm Games]]. The game was released for [[Windows]] and [[Xbox Series X/S]] in December 2024. A [[PlayStation 5]] version was released in April 2025, and a [[Nintendo Switch 2]] version was released in May 2026. The game received generally positive reviews, with critics praising the gameplay, level design, story, the performance of the cast, and its faithfulness to its source material. It attracted more than 4 million players. The game received multiple year-end nominations including [[D.I.C.E. Award for Game of the Year|Game of the Year]] at the [[D.I.C.E. Awards]], as well as [[British Academy Games Award for Best Game|Best Game]] at the [[22nd British Academy Games Awards]]. It received a [[Downloadable content|downloadable]] story expansion titled ''The Order of Giants'' in September 2025.

== Gameplay ==
[[File:Indiana Jones and the Great Circle gameplay screenshot.jpg|thumb|left|In the game, the player can pick up various objects and use them as melee weapons against enemies.]]
''Indiana Jones and the Great Circle'' is an [[action-adventure game]], in which the player assumes control of archaeologist [[Indiana Jones (character)|Indiana Jones]]. The game is primarily played from a [[First-person (video games)|first-person perspective]], but switches to a [[third-person view]] for cutscenes and certain gameplay actions, such as when Jones uses his whip to swing over gaps or when climbing pipes and walls.<ref name="Romano">{{cite magazine |last=Romano |first=Nick |date=January 18, 2024 |title=''The Last of Us'' star Troy Baker now tackles Indiana Jones |url=https://ew.com/indiana-jones-troy-baker-the-great-circle-exclusive-8426963 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240118222640/https://ew.com/indiana-jones-troy-baker-the-great-circle-exclusive-8426963 |archive-date=January 18, 2024 |access-date=January 18, 2024 |magazine=[[Entertainment Weekly]] |publisher=[[Dotdash Meredith]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pcgamer.com/thank-god-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-is-first-person/|title=Thank god Indiana Jones and the Great Circle is first-person|first=Wes|last=Fenlon|work=[[PC Gamer]]|date=January 19, 2024|accessdate=January 1, 2024|archive-date=January 19, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240119014000/https://www.pcgamer.com/thank-god-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-is-first-person/|url-status=live}}</ref> The player can separately adjust the difficulty of the game's combat and its puzzle-solving and exploration.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eurogamer.net/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-accessibility-options-let-you-tweak-how-many-enemies-you-face|title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle accessibility options let you tweak how many enemies you face|first=Victoria|last=Kennedy|work=[[Eurogamer]]|date=December 6, 2024|accessdate=January 1, 2025|archive-date=December 28, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241228175128/https://www.eurogamer.net/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-accessibility-options-let-you-tweak-how-many-enemies-you-face|url-status=live}}</ref>

Similar to [[immersive sim]]s, levels in the game have alternate routes for the player to reach their objectives.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vg247.com/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-hands-on-preview|title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle hands-on: a twisted love child of cinematic action, adventure games, and immersive sims – and I love it|first=Alex|last=Donaldson|work=[[VG247]]|date=October 29, 2024|accessdate=January 1, 2024|archive-date=November 11, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241111004346/https://www.vg247.com/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-hands-on-preview|url-status=live}}</ref> Some of the levels, such as Vatican City, Gizeh and Sukhothai, are larger, [[Open world|sandbox]] locations which can be explored freely by the player. In addition to the main quest, they may encounter other [[non-playable character]]s who will give them [[side quests]] tied to the main narrative, and discover [[collectible]]s such as ancient relics and medicine bottles. Through exploration, the player can also collect Adventure Books, providing permanent boosts in the game, improving weapon performance and durability, enhancing Jones's combat skills, and increasing his health and stamina.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pcgamesn.com/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle/missions-quests|title=All Indiana Jones and the Great Circle missions and side quests|first=Tom|last=Hopskins|work=[[PCGamesN]]|date=December 16, 2024|accessdate=January 1, 2024|archive-date=December 6, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241206003239/https://www.pcgamesn.com/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle/missions-quests|url-status=live}}</ref> The gameplay perks provided in Adventure Books must be unlocked using Adventure Points, which can be earned by photographing objects of interest, opening safes and chests, and collecting relics and field notes.<ref name="bandage">{{cite web|url=https://hardcoregamer.com/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-tips-and-tricks-we-wish-we-knew-sooner/|title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle: 8 Tips and Tricks We Wish We Knew Sooner|first=Sharon|last=Smith|work=Hardcore Gamer|date=December 22, 2024|accessdate=January 1, 2025|archive-date=December 23, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241223220632/https://hardcoregamer.com/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-tips-and-tricks-we-wish-we-knew-sooner/|url-status=live}}</ref> The player may also encounter various [[Puzzle video game|puzzles]], many of which are optional. Photographing a puzzle repeatedly using Jones's camera will provide them with additional hints for solving it.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pcgamer.com/games/adventure/before-googling-for-a-guide-in-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-give-the-in-game-hint-system-a-try-its-genuinely-the-best-one-ive-ever-seen-in-a-game/|title=Before Jones eventually unlocks more tools for exploration and solving puzzles, such as a [[lighter]] for illuminating dark areas and lighting torches,<ref>{{cite mask|rebreather]] that allows him to dive underwater.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamespot.com/gallery/indiana-jones-great-circle-serpents-chest/2900-6061/#3|title=Indiana Jones And The Great Circle – How To Open The Serpent's Chest|first=Jason|last=Rodriguez|work=[[GameSpot]]|date=December 11, 2024|accessdate=January 30, 2025|archive-date=January 13, The player can choose to use [[Stealth game|stealth]] tactics, such as crouching and hiding behind cover to avoid an enemy's line of sight, and hiding bodies from patrolling enemies.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://venturebeat.com/games/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-an-old-school-adventure-with-action-stealth-preview/|title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle – An old school adventure with action/stealth|first=Dean|last=Takahashi|work=[[VentureBeat]]|date=October 29, 2024|accessdate=January 30, 2025|archive-date=November 23, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241123074920/https://venturebeat.com/games/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-an-old-school-adventure-with-action-stealth-preview/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pcgamer.com/games/fps/after-three-hours-with-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-i-dont-think-its-the-grand-adventure-machinegames-is-pitching-its-just-a-fairly-basic-stealth-game/|title=After 3 hours with Indiana Jones and the Great Circle, I don't think it's the grand adventure MachineGames is pitching—it's just a fairly basic stealth game|first=Robin|last=Valentine|work=[[PC Gamer]]|date=October 29, 2024|accessdate=January 1, 2025|archive-date=January 3, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250103183539/https://www.pcgamer.com/games/fps/after-three-hours-with-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-i-dont-think-its-the-grand-adventure-machinegames-is-pitching-its-just-a-fairly-basic-stealth-game/|url-status=live}}</ref> Disguises can be worn to access restricted areas, though some high-level enemies can see through disguises; committing crimes such as stealing or behaving menacingly will also cause a disguise to fail.<ref name="GSpot tricks">{{cite web|url=https://www.gamespot.com/gallery/indiana-jones-great-circle-tips-to-know-before-you-play-beginners-guide/2900-6016/#3|title=Indiana Jones And The Great Circle Tips – 15 Things To Know Before You Play|first=Jason|last=Rodriguez|work=[[GameSpot]]|date=December 5, 2024|accessdate=January 1, 2025}}</ref> Jones can pick up various objects in the world, such as shovels, wrenches and broomsticks, and use them as makeshift weapons. They can also be thrown to distract enemies.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eurogamer.net/games-of-2024-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-had-this-years-most-approachable-high-stakes-stealth|title=Games of 2024: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle had this year's most approachable, high-stakes stealth|first=Marie|last=Pritchford|work=[[Eurogamer]]|date=December 27, 2024|accessdate=January 1, 2025|archive-date=December 30, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241230005703/https://www.eurogamer.net/games-of-2024-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-had-this-years-most-approachable-high-stakes-stealth|url-status=live}}</ref> While the weapons in the game are easily broken,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-review-a-grand-adventure-that-keeps-faith-with-the-movies|title=Indiana Jones And The Great Circle review: a grand adventure that keeps faith with the movies|first=Brendan|last=Caldwell|date=December 6, 2024|accessdate=January 1, 2025|work=[[Rock, Paper, Shotgun]]}}</ref> some can be repaired.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamesradar.com/games/action/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-tips/|title=10 Indiana Jones and the Great Circle tips and tricks we wish we knew before playing|first=Will|last=Sawyer|work=[[GamesRadar]]|date=December 17, 2024|accessdate=January 1, 2025|archive-date=January 14, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250114034152/https://www.gamesradar.com/games/action/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-tips/|url-status=live}}</ref> Jones is also equipped with a [[revolver]], though ammunition is scarce.<ref name="HCG combat"/> During [[Combat sport|melee fight]]s, Jones can punch hostile enemies with his fist, or push them away. He can also block and parry incoming attacks, or dodge them.<ref name="HCG combat"/> Jones's whip can be used for traversal, puzzle-solving, and combat. Targeting the upper limbs of an enemy disarms them, while targeting their lower limbs causes them to trip and fall towards Jones.<ref name="HCG combat">{{cite web|url=https://hardcoregamer.com/indiana-jones-great-circle-how-to-fight/|title=6 Tips for Fighting in Indiana Jones and the Great Circle|first=Sharon|last=Smith|work=Hardcore Gamer|date=December 30, 2024|accessdate=January 1, 2024|archive-date=January 8, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250108193338/https://hardcoregamer.com/indiana-jones-great-circle-how-to-fight/|url-status=live}}</ref>  All gameplay actions, such as fighting enemies, sprinting, and climbing, consume stamina, which regenerate slowly if he rests briefly.<ref name="IGNRev"/> Eating bread and fruits found in the game can provide additional bonuses to Jones's [[Health (gaming)|health]] and stamina, respectively, while using bandages restores lost health.<ref name="bandage"/>

== Plot ==
{{Multiple image
| total_width = 300
| image1      = Troy Baker Q&A (cropped).jpg
| image2      = Tony Todd (36141902441).jpg
| footer      = ''The Great Circle'' featured [[Troy Baker]] as [[Indiana Jones (character)|Indiana Jones]] and served as the final video game credit of actor [[Tony Todd]], who died a month before its release.
}}
In 1937, [[Indiana Jones (character)|Indiana Jones]] returns to Marshall College after leaving his fiancée [[Marion Ravenwood]]. A giant man named Locus breaks into the College, steals a cat mummy, and knocks Jones unconscious before leaving. Jones notices Locus's medallion bears a symbol resembling that of the [[Vatican Secret Archive]] and infiltrates [[Vatican City]] for answers. The city is under the control of Italian dictator [[Benito Mussolini]] and the [[Blackshirts]], who have been working with [[Nazi]] German archeologist and occultist Emmerich Voss. Jones meets reporter Ginetta "Gina" Lombardi, who is investigating Voss for her sister Laura's disappearance; the two team up. They discover that a tribe of giants called the "[[Nephilim]] Order" have been covertly working for the [[Roman Catholic Church]] to protect the secret of the "Great Circle", and that the cat mummy contains a special stone related to it. Voss steals the Order's stones and flees as Jones and Gina stow away on his zeppelin. Jones then explains the Great Circle is a group of sacred religious sites across the world that form a perfect circle, and that he fears that Voss has discovered some secret to its power.

Arriving at a Nazi dig in [[Gizeh]], Jones learns the Order has been working with Egyptians for thousands of years prior to the Catholic Church's foundation. The pair then finds the Idol of Ra to take its stone, but Voss recovers it and leaves Jones for dead in the desert. Gina rescues Jones and the pair travel to the [[Himalayas]], where they learn the third stone has transported a Nazi battleship from South America to the Himalayas. After finding Laura frozen to death, Jones is captured by a Nazi colonel named Viktor Gantz. Gina sets off a grenade, which allows Jones to escape but sends the Nazi battleship skidding down the mountain. Jones is able to use the third stone to open a portal, transporting them to [[Shanghai]] in the midst of the [[Battle of Shanghai|Japanese invasion of the city]], where Gantz dies. After hijacking a Japanese fighter plane, the pair travel to the nearest Great Circle ruin in [[Sukhothai (city)|Sukhothai]], [[Siam]]. Locus confronts them during their search, warning that the Great Circle's secret must never come to light, but Jones ignores his warnings. Voss attacks them as Jones collects the stone. As they escape, Gina is captured.

Seeing that Jones attaches more importance to Gina than the stones, Locus helps him follow Voss's trail. At the last site for the Great Circle, the [[Ziggurat of Ur]], Locus summons the Nephilim Order to attack the Nazis, allowing Jones to rescue Gina. Ignoring Locus's warnings, the pair travel deeper and find [[Noah's Ark]]. Voss captures them and reveals that the Great Circle is related to all of the [[flood myth]]s in history, with God granting [[Noah]] the power of the Great Circle to travel around the world to collect two of every animal and eventually repopulate the world. Voss intends to use this power to help the Nazis take over the world. Voss activates the Great Circle's power, causing another Great Flood. Voss brawls with Jones before being killed by the unstable power of the Ark. Locus teleports the Ark away through another portal, averting the flood. Afterwards, despite sharing feelings for each other, Gina parts ways with Jones for the sake of her career.

In a secret ending, Jones discovers a hidden mural showing all of the locations on the Great Circle pointing to the [[South Pole]]. There, footprints in the snow are seen leading away from Noah's Ark, suggesting that Locus has survived.

=== ''The Order of Giants'' ===
''The Order of Giants'' downloadable content takes place during the Vatican City portion of the main game. Indiana Jones encounters Father Orlando Ricci, a young scholar who is researching a legendary figure known as the Nameless Crusader. The Nameless Crusader's helmet and armor were ensconced in a secret chamber under a palace built by [[Pope Paul IV]]. Ricci was barred from the palace and he prevails upon Jones to search it and then visit him at his family estate in Rome to share his findings. Jones locates the armor and a key that opens a passage to the underground tomb of a giant named [[Junia (New Testament person)|Junia]], which holds the first of three pieces of a carved stone cylinder.

As he travels to Ricci's estate, Jones notices that Mussolini's Blackshirts are also looking for Ricci. Ricci and Jones deduce that the other two pieces of the cylinder can also be found in the secret tombs of two other giants: Abgal, an undefeated gladiator known as "the Minotaur," and Gibborim, the Nameless Crusader. Jones retrieves the cylinder pieces while encountering members of a modern [[Cult of Mithras]] lurking in Rome's sewers.

The cylinder reveals that it is a key to the resting chamber of the still-living Abgal. Ricci absconds with the cylinder and is exposed as the head of the Cult of Mithras. Ricci's goal has been to find Abgal and sacrifice him to gain enlightenment. Jones pursues Ricci into the temple, defeats the cult, and unseals the gate that leads to Abgal's chamber. Ricci ambushes Jones, but as the cultist attempts to stab Abgal, the giant awakens and strangles him. Abgal then raises his chamber into the center of the [[Colosseum]] and challenges Jones to a fight. Jones wins and then makes his way back to Vatican City.

The game was executively produced by [[Todd Howard]], a game director at [[Bethesda Game Studios]] known for his work on [[role-playing]] video games such as ''[[The Elder Scrolls]]'' and ''[[Fallout (franchise)|Fallout]]''. Howard, an ''[[Indiana Jones]]'' fan, had previously [[Pitch (filmmaking)|pitched]] such a game to franchise creator [[George Lucas]] around 2009,<ref>{{cite news |last=Silver |first=Dan |date=June 29, 2021 |title='I first pitched the game to Lucas in 2009!' – Todd Howard talks Indiana Jones (and Elder Scrolls 6) gaming classics to live up to |url=https://www.vg247.com/bethesda-indiana-jones-gaming-classics |website=VG247 |language=en-US |access-date=December 1, 2022 |archive-date=December 1, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221201161831/https://www.vg247.com/bethesda-indiana-jones-gaming-classics |url-status=live}}</ref>

[[MachineGames]] was chosen by Howard to develop the project because of its work on the ''[[Wolfenstein]]'' series, which also has Nazis as antagonists.<ref name="GS - Makuch">{{Cite web |last=Makuch |first=Eddie |date=November 10, 2021 |title=Elder Scrolls Boss Todd Howard Clarifies His Involvement In New Indiana Jones Game |url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/elder-scrolls-boss-todd-howard-clarifies-his-involvement-in-new-indiana-jones-game/1100-6497886/ |website=GameSpot |language=en-US |access-date=December 11, 2021 |archive-date=December 11, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211211192729/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/elder-scrolls-boss-todd-howard-clarifies-his-involvement-in-new-indiana-jones-game/1100-6497886/ |url-status=live}}</ref> Jerk Gustafsson served as the game's director. Jens Andersson joined the project as design director in late 2022, after formerly being hired in the same position for the previously pitched game. Andersson had also served as lead designer on ''[[The Chronicles of Riddick: Escape from Butcher Bay]]'' (2004) and ''[[The Darkness (video game)|The Darkness]]'' (2007). The ''Indiana Jones'' team included more than 20 developers who previously worked on ''The Darkness''.<ref>{{cite web |last=Robinson |first=Andy |date=December 1, 2022 |title=The Darkness, Chronicles of Riddick director joins Indiana Jones team |url=https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/the-darkness-chronicles-of-riddick-director-joins-indiana-jones-team/ |website=Video Games Chronicle |language=en-US |access-date=May 24, 2023 |archive-date=May 21, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230521044314/https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/the-darkness-chronicles-of-riddick-director-joins-indiana-jones-team/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Wales |first=Matt |date=December 1, 2022 |title=The Darkness and Chronicles of Riddick lead designer joins MachineGames' Indiana Jones |url=https://www.eurogamer.net/the-darkness-and-chronicles-of-riddick-lead-designer-joins-machinegames-indiana-jones |website=Eurogamer |language=en-GB |access-date=May 24, 2023 |archive-date=January 29, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230129062114/https://www.eurogamer.net/the-darkness-and-chronicles-of-riddick-lead-designer-joins-machinegames-indiana-jones |url-status=live }}</ref> Development of the game lasted for more than five years.<ref name="Maas 2024">{{cite web |last=Maas |first=Jennifer |date=December 6, 2024 |title=How 'Indiana Jones' and 'Call of Duty' Are Pushing Xbox Ahead of PlayStation, Nintendo in a Next Gen Console-Less Holiday Season |url=https://variety.com/2024/gaming/news/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-preview-video-game-plot-details-1236233902/ |work=Variety |language=en-US |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=October 4, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251004025015/https://variety.com/2024/gaming/news/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-preview-video-game-plot-details-1236233902/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== Gameplay ===
[[File:Vatican City and St. Peter Square evening twilight aerial view.jpg|thumb|left|[[Vatican City]] serves as one of the game's hub locations that the player can revisit multiple times.]]

Several levels in the game are large, non-linear levels, as the team wanted to extend the game's longevity. The team experimented with the Uberkommandant missions in ''[[Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus]]'' (2017), which allowed players revisit levels, and they were inspired by ''[[Metro Exodus]]''{{'}}s (2019) structure, in which the game had a linear narrative while still having large, sandbox areas where players have more freedom to explore and complete side content. Vatican City was the first such "hub" level and served as the game's [[vertical slice]]. The team described the Vatican as the most complicated level in the game because it was the level where the developers experimented with different design choices. They decided early on that it cannot be a one-to-one recreation of the city, as they were unable to funnel players across major locations of the map or have them explore certain key buildings or areas.<ref name="noclip"/> To enhance the sandbox experience, the team initially designed "treasure hunts", which were essentially [[fetch quest]]s that guide players across various map locations, though these were later reworked into 'mysteries' with richer narratives. These quests were mainly short activities—or ones that enriched the main narrative—as the team did not want to them to draw the player's attention away from the optimal path. Mysteries were primarily intended to enliven the game's world, with the player encountering these optional narratives simply through exploration, evoking a sense of adventure. To ensure the depiction of the locations in the game were authentic, the team read books and images and reimagined how they would have looked in the 1930s.<ref name="wired"/>

Design of some of these locations was inspired by [[immersive sim]]s, which give multiple ways for players to infiltrate and reach their objectives.<ref name="pcgint"/> Disguises introduced an additional way for players to interact with the map and the environment. The team also worked to ensure the game was immersive, making sure that the game's [[user interface]] is presented diegetically using Indiana's journal. Hannah Hoffman, a member of the level design team, also pushed for having a "living world", in which players can identify small ways to interact with non-player characters by being attentive.<ref name="noclip"/> An optional waypoint system was added to the game late in its development.<ref name="audio1">{{cite web |last=Yin-Poole |first=Wesley |date=August 11, 2025 |title=Whipping Up a Storm: How Indiana Jones and the Great Circle Took Big Last-Minute Changes on the Chin To Become a Hit With Critics and Players |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/whipping-up-a-storm-how-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-took-big-last-minute-changes-on-the-chin-to-become-a-hit-with-critics-and-players|work=[[IGN]]|accessdate=October 26, 2025|archive-date=October 7, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251007184209/https://www.ign.com/articles/whipping-up-a-storm-how-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-took-big-last-minute-changes-on-the-chin-to-become-a-hit-with-critics-and-players|url-status=live}}</ref> Like prior projects from MachineGames, the game uses first-person perspective, making it distinct from third-person adventure games. The first-person viewpoint was also chosen to immerse the player in the role of Indiana Jones. Certain actions and cutscenes switch to third-person, to show the character on-screen as much as possible.<ref name=YinPoole>{{cite web |last=Yin-Poole |first=Wesley |date=January 19, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle Dev Explains Decision to Go First-Person Over Third-Person |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-dev-explains-decision-to-go-first-person-over-third-person |website=IGN |language=en-US |access-date=January 19, 2024 |archive-date=January 19, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240119112434/https://www.ign.com/articles/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-dev-explains-decision-to-go-first-person-over-third-person |url-status=live }}</ref> As with ''Wolfenstein II'', the team built a full-body model of the [[player character]], which can be seen from a first-person perspective.<ref name="noclip"/> 

The character of Indiana Jones himself served as a guide for gameplay design, as developers wanted to ensure that every action he takes feels in character. According to creative director Axel Torvenius, Indiana is not a gunslinger and instead a "teacher and a somewhat clumsy archeologist". As a result, the team deprioritized the use of guns in combat and positioned them as a last resort. Though many guns are available, Indiana is easily killed during gunfights, and using firearms will attract the attention of other enemies in the area.<ref>{{cite web |last=Vitelli |first=Jesse |date=September 7, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle devs put a focus on the "danger level" of using guns because "Indy doesn't have superpowers" |url=https://www.gamesradar.com/games/adventure/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-devs-put-a-focus-on-the-danger-level-of-using-guns-because-indy-doesnt-have-superpowers/|work=GamesRadar+ |language=en-GB |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=October 3, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251003040310/https://www.gamesradar.com/games/adventure/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-devs-put-a-focus-on-the-danger-level-of-using-guns-because-indy-doesnt-have-superpowers/ |url-status=live}}</ref> The game was designed to be generous, as developers considered Indiana Jones a lucky character. Therefore, the team populated it with abundant pick-ups and ensured he could quickly escape combat, so the player never feels compelled to fire a gun.<ref name="noclip"/> As the team was used to making [[Run and gun video game|run and gun]] games using heavy weaponry in the ''Wolfenstein'' series, it took the team a lot of time to readjust for a slower-paced gameplay.<ref name="TRadar"/> Describing Indiana as an "unlikely" hero, the team wanted the melee combat system to be "semi-chaotic", in which Indiana must rely on his wits and improvise using what he can find. As a result, the game has a lot of environmental objects, including guns, that the player can pick up and use as a melee weapons.<ref name="pcgint">{{cite web|url=https://www.pcgamer.com/games/fps/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-devs-say-an-indy-game-could-never-be-a-shooter-should-never-be-a-shooter-so-they-re-embracing-his-signature-whip-improvised-brawls-and-disguise-based-stealth-instead/|title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle devs say an Indy game 'could never be a shooter, should never be a shooter,' so they're embracing his signature whip, improvised brawls, and disguise-based stealth instead|first=Ted|last=Litchfield|work=[[PC Gamer]]|date=August 25, 2024|accessdate=October 26, 2025|archive-date=July 10, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250710114808/https://www.pcgamer.com/games/fps/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-devs-say-an-indy-game-could-never-be-a-shooter-should-never-be-a-shooter-so-they-re-embracing-his-signature-whip-improvised-brawls-and-disguise-based-stealth-instead/|url-status=live}}</ref> Designing the whip, especially its [[game physics]] and simulation, was also difficult for MachineGames, especially as level designers felt it necessary to create scenarios in the game where the whip is consistently implemented. The team consulted with a Swedish bullwhip champion to record visual and audio references.<ref>{{cite web |last=Wald |first=Heather |date=September 3, 2024 |title=From playing dress-up to whipping everything in sight, Indiana Jones and the Great Circle is driven by one question: "What would Indiana Jones do?" |url=https://www.gamesradar.com/games/adventure/from-playing-dress-up-to-whipping-everything-in-sight-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-is-driven-by-one-question-what-would-indiana-jones-do/ |work=GamesRadar+ |language=en-GB |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=September 20, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240920160831/https://www.gamesradar.com/games/adventure/from-playing-dress-up-to-whipping-everything-in-sight-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-is-driven-by-one-question-what-would-indiana-jones-do/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

Andersson described ''The Great Circle'' as an "adventure-first" video game.<ref>{{cite web |last=Indovina |first=Kurt |date=September 5, 2024 |title=Wolfenstein Developer Is Doing More Than Just Making An Indiana Jones Game, It's Innovating A Genre |url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/wolfenstein-developer-is-doing-more-than-just-making-an-indiana-jones-game/1100-6526313/ |work=GameSpot |language=en-US |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=November 14, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241114043510/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/wolfenstein-developer-is-doing-more-than-just-making-an-indiana-jones-game/1100-6526313/ |url-status=live}}</ref> Early in development, the team created a pie chart denoting the proportion of the game devoted to six pillars: Hand-to-Hand, Platforming, Exploration & Puzzles, Infiltration, Set-Pieces, and Shooting.<ref>{{cite web |last=Roberts |first=Samuel |date=May 7, 2025 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle's Jens Andersson on defining 'a MachineGames adventure' |url=https://www.gamesindustry.biz/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circles-jens-andersson-on-defining-a-machinegames-adventure |work=[[Gameindustry.biz]] |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=May 16, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250516164426/https://www.gamesindustry.biz/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circles-jens-andersson-on-defining-a-machinegames-adventure|url-status=live}}</ref> The team took an extensive amount of time balancing different facets of gameplay, and attempted to juxtapose setpieces with slower moments in which Indiana is simply exploring the environment and unraveling its mysteries.<ref>{{cite web |last=Donaldson |first=Alex |date=October 29, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle hands-on: a twisted love child of cinematic action, adventure games, and immersive sims – and I love it |url=https://www.vg247.com/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-hands-on-preview |work=VG247 |language=en-GB |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=October 8, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251008081129/https://www.vg247.com/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-hands-on-preview |url-status=live}}</ref> Adventure games by [[LucasArts]], such as ''[[Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis]]'' (1992), served as sources of inspiration for the team.<ref>{{cite web |last=Fillari |first=Alessandro |date=October 29, 2024 |title=In Indiana Jones and The Great Circle, MachineGames wants players to improv like Indy |url=https://www.gamedeveloper.com/design/in-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-machinegames-wants-players-to-improvise-like-indy |work=Game Developer |language=en-US |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=September 18, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250918232639/https://www.gamedeveloper.com/design/in-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-machinegames-wants-players-to-improvise-like-indy |url-status=live}}</ref> Puzzles in the game were designed to be complicated and varied. However, the team feared players may visit [[YouTube]] to look for solutions while playing the game, breaking their immersion. Therefore, they implemented a hint system in which Indiana will provide additional clues whenever the player takes a picture of a puzzle.<ref>{{cite web |last=Litchfield |first=Ted |date=August 26, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle will have challenging puzzles, but also a creative hint system through Indy's camera: 'We don't want you to go to YouTube to look up the solution, because that's immersion-breaking and bad' |url=https://www.pcgamer.com/games/fps/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-will-have-challenging-puzzles-but-also-a-creative-hint-system-through-indys-camera-we-dont-want-you-to-go-to-youtube-to-look-up-the-solution-because-thats-immersion-breaking-and-bad/ |work=PC Gamer |language=en-GB |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=May 20, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250520162330/https://www.pcgamer.com/games/fps/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-will-have-challenging-puzzles-but-also-a-creative-hint-system-through-indys-camera-we-dont-want-you-to-go-to-youtube-to-look-up-the-solution-because-thats-immersion-breaking-and-bad/ |url-status=live}}</ref> To make the game more accessible and support players who are uninterested in solving puzzles, the game allows players to separately lower the difficulty of adventure aspect of the game.<ref>{{cite web |last=Skrebels |first=Joe |date=December 2, 2024 |title=Mechanisms Become Mechanics: Inventing Puzzles for Indiana Jones and the Great Circle |url=https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2024/12/02/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-puzzles-interview/ |work=Xbox Wire |language=en-US |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=August 3, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250803182917/https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2024/12/02/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-puzzles-interview/|url-status=live}}</ref>

=== Story, characters and casting ===
The team developed the narrative of the game first.<ref name="noclip">{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FsxTQvo5QhM|title=The Making of Indiana Jones and the Great Circle|work=[[Noclip]]|date=September 30, 2025|accessdate=October 26, 2025}}</ref> It was always considered to be a globe-trotting adventure, as the team felt that limiting players to one location would not be exciting, and that the game would have better pacing if different biomes are introduced.<ref name="TRadar">{{cite web |last=Wood |first=Dashiell |date=October 29, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle let me pelt Nazis with bottles, shovels, and various foods – in short, it absolutely rocks |url=https://www.techradar.com/gaming/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-let-me-pelt-nazis-with-bottles-shovels-and-various-foods-in-short-it-absolutely-rocks |work=TechRadar |language=en-GB |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=May 24, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250524224150/https://www.techradar.com/gaming/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-let-me-pelt-nazis-with-bottles-shovels-and-various-foods-in-short-it-absolutely-rocks |url-status=live}}</ref> Howard also helped conceived the story, in particularly the Great Circle concept.<ref name="noclip"/> Gustafsson was heavily inspired by ''Raiders of the Lost Ark'' and matinee adventure movies, and envisioned ''The Great Circle'' as a "lost Indiana Jones adventure from the 1980s",<ref name="dl"/><ref>{{cite web |title=How Machine Games balanced action and comedy in the Indiana Jones video game |url=https://gamesbeat.com/how-machine-games-balanced-action-and-comedy-in-the-indiana-jones-video-game-interview/ |work=GamesBeat |language=en-US |date=September 3, 2024 |access-date=October 26, 2025}}</ref> one that evokes the same "tone and spirit" without repeating old plot threads.<ref name="movie magic"/> The team collaborated with cinematographer Kyle Klutz, who served as the game's Director of Photography, in order to imitate the filmmaking style and cinematography of [[Steven Spielberg]]'s films.<ref name="dl">{{cite web |last=Jackson |first=Destiny |date=December 23, 2024 |title='Indiana Jones And The Great Circle' Director Jerk Gustafsson And Lucasfilm Games VP & GM Douglas Reilly On "Evolving" An Icon |url=https://deadline.com/2024/12/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-director-interview-1236240994/ |work=Deadline |language=en-US |access-date=October 26, 2025}}</ref> ''The Great Circle'' was MachineGames' biggest game to date, with nearly four hours of cutscenes.<ref>{{cite web |last=Carpenter |first=Lincoln |work=PC Gamer |date=November 27, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle has a face-melting 4 hours of cutscenes: 'This is the biggest and longest game that Machine Games have ever done' |url=https://www.pcgamer.com/games/fps/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-has-a-face-melting-4-hours-of-cutscenes-this-is-the-biggest-and-longest-game-that-machine-games-have-ever-done/ |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=July 12, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250712190311/https://www.pcgamer.com/games/fps/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-has-a-face-melting-4-hours-of-cutscenes-this-is-the-biggest-and-longest-game-that-machine-games-have-ever-done/ |url-status=live}}</ref> Due to the frequent appearance of the Axis Powers' forces and [[propaganda]] in the game, the game also includes a [[cultural sensitivity]] warning that appears when the player begins the game for the first time, indicating that the game and its developers condemn the Axis Powers' war crimes.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Middler |first1=Jordan |date=October 29, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle includes warning denouncing Nazis |url=https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-includes-warning-denouncing-nazis/ |website=Video Games Chronicle |language=en-GB |access-date=January 23, 2025 |archive-date=December 14, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241214152011/https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-includes-warning-denouncing-nazis/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

The game uses Indiana Jones actor [[Harrison Ford]]'s likeness, while [[Troy Baker]] provides voiceover work for the character. Ford was never considered to reprise the role due to his age, while Howard initially did not want Baker for the role (as he told him in a [[Zoom (software)|Zoom]] meeting).<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Yang |first=George |date=October 30, 2024 |title=How the New 'Indiana Jones' Video Game Got Its Star |url=https://www.rollingstone.com/culture/rs-gaming/indiana-jones-todd-howard-bethesda-troy-baker-1235146294/ |magazine=Rolling Stone |language=en-US |access-date=October 31, 2024 |archive-date=October 31, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241031151621/https://www.rollingstone.com/culture/rs-gaming/indiana-jones-todd-howard-bethesda-troy-baker-1235146294/ |url-status=live}}</ref> Baker initially turned down the role upon being approached as he found the offer too daunting, but MachineGames' motion capture team changed his mind. He [[audition]]ed with dozens of actors until only he and another actor remained, as the team chose Baker every time despite him not impressing Howard at first.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Rogers |first=Andrew |date=December 8, 2024 |title=How one of gaming's best-known actors took on one of film's biggest roles |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn08epwy152o |website=BBC News |language=en-GB |access-date=April 27, 2025 |archive-date=April 18, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250418163257/https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn08epwy152o |url-status=live}}</ref> As Indiana is a [[polyglot]], Baker worked with language coaches to ensure he could perform some of his lines in Italian or Latin.<ref name="wired">{{cite web |last=Franklin II |first=Anthony |date=December 14, 2024 |title=How MachineGames Filled a Gap in Indiana Jones' History (Interview) |url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/how-machinegames-filled-a-gap-in-indiana-jones-history-interview/ |work=Vice |language=en-US |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=February 13, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250213091924/https://www.vice.com/en/article/how-machinegames-filled-a-gap-in-indiana-jones-history-interview/ |url-status=live}}</ref> The story of the game reveals an impulsive side of Indiana,<ref>{{cite web |last=Bailey |first=Kat |date=October 30, 2024 |title=We Ask the Indiana Jones Devs If Great Circle's Story Is Canon And Whether You Can Choose Poorly |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/indiana-jones-devs-interview-machine-games-lucasfilm-games |work=IGN |language=en-US |access-date=October 24, 2025 |archive-date=August 29, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250829183924/https://www.ign.com/articles/indiana-jones-devs-interview-machine-games-lucasfilm-games |url-status=live}}</ref> and explores his "obsession" with the past and how they prevented him from maintaining relationships with the ones he loved.<ref name="dl"/> The writers used recurring characters, including [[Marcus Brody]] and [[Marion Ravenwood]], to set up the adventure early in the game, before introducing the new characters.<ref name="wired"/>

{{multiple image
| align       = right
| direction   = horizontal
| total_width = 300
| image1      = Alessandra-Mastronardi-LAllieva-Spettacolo-Italiano-Alberto-Fuschi.jpg
| image2      = Marios Gavrilis.jpg
| footer      = [[Alessandra Mastronardi]] (left) and [[Marios Gavrilis]] (right) played Gina Lombardi and Emmerich Voss, respectively.
}}

Other voice actors included [[Alessandra Mastronardi]] as Gina Lombardi, [[Marios Gavrilis]] as Emmerich Voss, and [[Tony Todd]] as Locus in his final voice acting role. Todd was brought into the project after Torvenius and other developers half-jokingly pitched Todd for the role out of dissatisfaction with the actors who had auditioned for the role, as they had not brought enough depth to Locus. Once Todd turned out to be available, developers felt he brought an entirely different angle to the character's background, so he was offered the role.<ref>{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqCa62gLW8c |title=How Troy Baker became Indiana Jones in MachineGames' The Great Circle |publisher=[[BAFTA]] |access-date=April 27, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250317014631/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqCa62gLW8c |archive-date=March 17, 2025 |url-status=live |via=[[YouTube]]}}</ref> Gavrilis auditioned for the role under the impression the game was a new ''Wolfenstein'' entry until he was informed about its true nature in late 2021; he felt that had he been told beforehand, he would have failed his audition. To portray Voss, Gavrilis rewatched the Indiana Jones films, paying special attention to [[Ronald Lacey]]'s [[List of Indiana Jones characters#Arnold Toht|Arnold Toht]] and [[Paul Freeman (actor)|Paul Freeman]]'s [[List of Indiana Jones characters#|René Belloq]], and injected "a bit of [[Klaus Kinski]] flavour" to his performance.<ref name="HowToBringVossToLife">{{cite web |last=Kennedy |date=January 9, 2025 |first=Victoria |title=Becoming Voss: Bringing Indiana Jones and the Great Circle's incredibly punchable bad guy to life with Marios Gavrilis |url=https://www.eurogamer.net/becoming-voss-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-marios-gavrilis-interview |website=Eurogamer |language=en-GB |access-date=April 27, 2025 |archive-date=April 21, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250421115515/https://www.eurogamer.net/becoming-voss-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-marios-gavrilis-interview |url-status=live}}</ref> Gustafsson described Voss as a "hobby psychologist" who used Indiana's obsession with the past against him.<ref name="wired"/> Gavrilis described Voss as "radical and unapologetic", and remarked that he had "[[Joker (character)|Joker]]-like qualities, almost like a God-level [[Troll (slang)|troll]], a school bully who took shithousery to a whole different level, backing it up with true knowledge and skill". Stuntman Nicklas Hansson briefly took over for Gavrilis on set when Gavrilis was infected with [[COVID-19]].<ref name="HowToBringVossToLife" />

=== Audio ===
The audio team, led by Peter Ward, rewatched the films and recreated [[Ben Burtt]]'s sound design for the game. According to Ward, the team "did hundreds of hours of original recordings, using props like the whip, the fedora, the leather jacket, and lots of different shoe types on lots of different surfaces".<ref name="movie magic">{{cite web |last=Skrebels |first=Joe |date=November 25, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle: Bringing '80s Movie Magic to a 2024 Game |url=https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2024/11/25/indiana-jones-great-circle-recreating-movie-magic-interview/ |work=Xbox Wire |language=en-US |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=May 21, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250521153611/https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2024/11/25/indiana-jones-great-circle-recreating-movie-magic-interview/ |url-status=live}}</ref> The soundtrack was composed by [[Gordy Haab]], based on the work of [[John Williams]], who composed the film scores. Haab and 86 musicians recorded the game's score at [[Abbey Road Studios]], where Williams originally recorded ''[[Raiders of the Lost Ark (soundtrack)|Raiders of the Lost Ark]]'' (1981).<ref name="HowRecordedScore"/> Certain soundtrack pieces, such as "Marion's Theme" and "Raiders March", had to be re-recorded and re-orchestrated due to [[mechanical license|mechanical copyright]].<ref name="audio1"/> Haab chose percussion instruments he described as "very interesting", like the [[Jawbone (instrument)|jawbone]], to create an environment that gives a sense of space to the game.<ref name="HowRecordedScore">{{Cite AV media |publisher=[[Bethesda Softworks]] |date=April 16, 2025 |title=Sounds of Adventure: The Making of Indiana Jones and the Great Circle |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3foAfyNHQEM |access-date=April 17, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250417072712/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3foAfyNHQEM |archive-date=April 17, 2025 |url-status=live |via=[[YouTube]]}}</ref>

=== Technology ===
''Indiana Jones and the Great Circle'' was developed using MachineGames's custom [[Fork (software development)|fork]] of [[id Tech&nbsp;7]], branded as Motor.<ref name="Morgan 2025"/><ref name="Kulikov 2025"/> The game was built around [[Ray tracing (graphics)|ray tracing]], requiring [[Ray tracing hardware|hardware-accelerated ray tracing]] on all platforms.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Archer |first1=James |date=December 6, 2024 |title=Mandatory ray tracing makes Indiana Jones and the Great Circle pretty yet brutal, like Indy himself |url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-pc-performance-best-settings |website=Rock, Paper, Shotgun |language=en-GB |access-date=May 4, 2026}}</ref> Ray-traced [[global illumination]] (RTGI) is used for calculating indirect lighting from sources like the sun, exhibiting natural light fall-off, contact shadows and shadowed crevices.<ref name="Linneman 2024">{{cite web |last1=Linneman |first1=John |date=December 6, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle tech review: an incredible achievement |url=https://www.digitalfoundry.net/articles/digitalfoundry-2024-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-tech-review |website=Digital Foundry |language=en-GB |access-date=May 4, 2026}}</ref> MachineGames partnered with [[Nvidia]] to implement [[path tracing]], known as "full ray tracing", on Windows.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Phillips Kennedy |first1=Victoria |date=December 9, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle first update adds full ray tracing on PC |url=https://www.eurogamer.net/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-first-update-adds-full-ray-tracing-on-pc |website=Eurogamer |language=en-GB |access-date=}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Phillips Kennedy |first1=Victoria |date=December 9, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle first update adds full ray tracing on PC |url=https://www.eurogamer.net/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-first-update-adds-full-ray-tracing-on-pc |website=Eurogamer |language=en-GB |access-date=May 4, 2026}}</ref> Path tracing replaces static [[cube maps]] used on glass reflections, and ray-traced sun shadows are calculated on a per-pixel basis.<ref name="Battaglia 2024b">{{cite web |last1=Battaglia |first1=Alex |date=December 14, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle's full ray tracing upgrade is beautiful |url=https://www.digitalfoundry.net/articles/digitalfoundry-2024-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circles-full-ray-tracing-upgrade-is-spectacular |website=Digital Foundry |language=en-GB |access-date=May 4, 2026}}</ref> All cutscenes are rendered in [[Real-time computer graphics|real time]] with [[16:9]] and cinematic [[21:9]] options.<ref name="Linneman 2024"/>

Hair rendering uses a strand-based system to represent individual strands rather than the traditional hair cards technique. MachineGames chose to use hair strands due to the game's cinematic cutscenes where detailed character faces are often close to the camera; it also simplified the artists' creation workflow. Weaker devices like the [[Steam Deck]] and [[Xbox Series S]] feature less than half the maximum hair strands of other platforms. Hair strands are used for most characters; MachineGames experimented with strands for animal fur but limited them for certain animals like spiders and monkeys.<ref name="Kulikov 2025">{{cite conference |last1=Kulikov |first1=Sergei |date=August 12, 2025 |title=Strand-based hair and fur in ''Indiana Jones and the Great Circle'' |url=https://advances.realtimerendering.com/s2025/content/Strand%20Hair%20in%20IJGC%20-%20Final%20Slides%20(Post-Conference).pdf |website=Advances in Real-Time Rendering |conference=SIGGRAPH |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2026}}</ref> ''Indiana Jones and the Great Circle'' was the first game to support RTX Hair, added in September 2025 to more accurately light hair with path tracing.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Rutherford |first1=Amber |date=August 20, 2025 |title=Nvidia's RTX Hair To Make Debut In Indiana Jones and the Great Circle |url=https://80.lv/articles/nvidia-s-rtx-hair-to-make-debut-in-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle |website=80 Level |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2026}}</ref> RTX Hair uses Linear Swept Spheres, a new sphere [[Geometric primitive|primitive]] introduced with Nvidia's [[GeForce RTX 50 series]] graphics cards to better represent hair strand geometry; it reduces geometry needed to render hair strands and their representation in the [[bounding volume hierarchy]] compared to using triangle primitives.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Edser |first1=Andy |date=August 18, 2025 |title=Nvidia's RTX Hair feature looks set to give the cast of Indiana Jones and the Great Circle some fabulously luscious locks |url=https://www.pcgamer.com/hardware/graphics-cards/nvidias-rtx-hair-feature-looks-set-to-give-the-cast-of-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-some-fabulously-luscious-locks/ |website=PC Gamer |language=en-GB |access-date=May 4, 2026}}</ref>

To hit the performance target on consoles, MachineGames degraded RTGI quality rather than eliminate it entirely; it is lower on consoles than the lowest-quality RTGI setting on Windows.<ref name="Battaglia 2024a">{{cite web |last1=Battaglia |first1=Alex |date=December 7, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle PC: impressive performance – but care is needed with 8GB graphics cards |url=https://www.digitalfoundry.net/articles/digitalfoundry-2024-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-pc-impressive-performance-but-care-is-needed-with-8gb-graphics-cards |website=Digital Foundry |language=en-GB |access-date=May 4, 2026}}</ref> The game relies on variable rate shading on Xbox Series X/S, reducing quality in some areas of the frame to maintain performance targets. Xbox Series X renders at internal [[Display resolution|resolution]] of [[1800p]] with [[dynamic resolution scaling]] to maintain 60 [[frames per second]] (FPS) with id Tech's [[temporal anti-aliasing]] solution.<ref name="Linneman 2024"/> PlayStation 5 is similar, running at 1200p to 1800p, while the [[PlayStation 5 Pro]] operates at a higher dynamic resolution range of [[1440p]] to [[4K resolution|4K]].<ref name="Morgan 2025">{{cite web |last1=Morgan |first1=Thomas |date=April 19, 2025 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle on PS5: excellent game, solid port |url=https://www.digitalfoundry.net/articles/digitalfoundry-2025-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-on-ps5-excellent-game-solid-port |website=Digital Foundry |language=en-GB |access-date=May 4, 2026}}</ref> The weaker Xbox Series S features graphical cutbacks, running at a [[1080p]] resolution at 60 FPS, and a reduced [[Data storage|file size]].<ref name="Linneman 2024"/>

MachineGames were notified late in production that a [[Nintendo Switch 2]] version was possible.<ref name="Van der Biest 2026"/> MachineGames wanted to ensure the Switch 2 had comparable visual quality to the other consoles versions without cutting content. An initial concern was that [[Non-player character|NPC]] crowd density would need to be reduced due to the system's low power CPU limitations, but only one specific area was impacted.<ref name="Van der Biest 2026">{{cite web |last1=Van der Biest |first1=Lander |date=April 30, 2026 |title=Interview: Bringing Indiana Jones and the Great Circle to Nintendo Switch 2 |url=https://gamingboulevard.com/2026/04/interview-bringing-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-to-nintendo-switch-2/ |website=Gaming Boulevard |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2026}}</ref> Torvenius considered its visual quality equal to the Xbox Series{{nbsp}}S.<ref name="Norman 2026">{{cite web |last1=Norman |first1=Jim |date=April 30, 2026 |title=Feature: 'It Is Just One-To-One' – MachineGames Talks Preserving 'Indiana Jones And The Great Circle' On Switch 2 |url=https://www.nintendolife.com/features/it-is-just-one-to-one-machinegames-talks-preserving-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-on-switch-2 |website=Nintendo Life |language=en-GB |access-date=May 4, 2026}}</ref> MachineGames capped the frame rate at {{nowrap|30 FPS}} to maintain consistent performance at their desired visual quality.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Leadbetter |first1=Richard |date=February 14, 2026 |title=Indiana Jones on Switch 2: The Next Big Test For Current-Gen Ports? |url=https://www.digitalfoundry.net/news/2026/02/indiana-jones-on-switch-2-the-next-big-test-for-current-gen-ports |website=Digital Foundry |language=en-GB |access-date=May 4, 2026}}</ref> When docked, the Switch 2 version is rendered at 540p internal resolution with upscaling to 1080p using [[DLSS]];<ref name="Judd 2026">{{cite web |last1=Judd |first1=William |date=May 13, 2026 |title=Indiana Jones and The Great Circle Arrives Surprisingly Intact on Switch 2 |url=https://www.digitalfoundry.net/reviews/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-arrives-surprisingly-intact-on-switch-2 |website=Digital Foundry |language=en-GB |access-date=May 13, 2026}}</ref> output resolution is lowered to 720p in handheld mode.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Talbot |first1=Ken |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle Review (Switch 2) |url=https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/nintendo-switch-2/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle |website=Nintendo Life |language=en-GB |access-date=May 13, 2026}}</ref> Textures and audio were compressed to fit within a [[Switch&nbsp;2 game card]] instead of using a [[Game-Key Card]], which MachineGames considered important so players would not require an online connection.<ref name="Judd 2026"/><ref name="Norman 2026"/>

== Release ==
The game's announcement in 2021 was accompanied by a teaser trailer which included various [[Easter egg (media)|Easter eggs]] and hints about the game's setting.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Oloman |first=Jordan |date=January 13, 2021 |title=Indiana Jones Trailer Breakdown: Setting, Timeline, and Easter Eggs Explained |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/indiana-jones-trailer-breakdown-setting-timeline-and-easter-eggs-explained |website=IGN |language=en-US |access-date=December 11, 2021 |archive-date=December 11, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211211192803/https://www.ign.com/articles/indiana-jones-trailer-breakdown-setting-timeline-and-easter-eggs-explained |url-status=live}}</ref> The game's title, story details, and first gameplay footage were unveiled on January 18, 2024, during the [[Xbox Developer Direct]] video presentation.<ref name="VG - Borthwick">{{Cite web |last=Borthwick |first=Ben |date=January 18, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and The Great Circle is the official name of MachineGames' Indy game |url=https://www.videogamer.com/news/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-is-the-official-name-of-machinegames-indy-game/ |website=VideoGamer |language=en-US |access-date=January 18, 2024 |archive-date=January 19, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240119012119/https://www.videogamer.com/news/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-is-the-official-name-of-machinegames-indy-game/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

''Indiana Jones and the Great Circle'' was released on December 9, 2024, for [[Windows]] and [[Xbox Series X/S]] as a timed [[console exclusive]]. The original contract between Bethesda and Lucasfilm parent [[Disney]] stipulated that the game would launch as a multiplatform game, but this was amended to exclude a [[PlayStation 5]] version when Microsoft acquired Bethesda's parent company [[ZeniMax Media]] in March 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Warren |first=Tom |date=June 22, 2023 |title=Bethesda's Indiana Jones game is exclusive to Xbox and PC |url=https://www.theverge.com/2023/6/22/23770141/bethesda-indiana-jones-game-xbox-pc-exclusive |website=The Verge |language=en-US |access-date=August 16, 2023 |archive-date=June 22, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230622181716/https://www.theverge.com/2023/6/22/23770141/bethesda-indiana-jones-game-xbox-pc-exclusive |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Plant |first=Logan |date=June 22, 2023 |title=MachineGames' Indiana Jones Game Was Originally Planned for Release on PS5 |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/machinegames-indiana-jones-game-was-originally-planned-for-release-on-ps5 |website=IGN |language=en-US |access-date=January 16, 2024 |archive-date=January 12, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240112144031/https://www.ign.com/articles/machinegames-indiana-jones-game-was-originally-planned-for-release-on-ps5 |url-status=live}}</ref> Disney felt that Windows and Xbox Series X/S made up a large-enough marketplace to justify exclusivity.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Gilbert |first=Fraser |date=December 12, 2023 |title=Disney Addresses Xbox Exclusivity Questions For Indiana Jones & Marvel's Blade |url=https://www.purexbox.com/news/2023/12/disney-addresses-xbox-exclusivity-questions-for-indiana-jones-and-marvels-blade |website=Pure Xbox |language=en-GB |access-date=January 11, 2024 |archive-date=January 11, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240111044926/https://www.purexbox.com/news/2023/12/disney-addresses-xbox-exclusivity-questions-for-indiana-jones-and-marvels-blade |url-status=live}}</ref> Despite this, a PlayStation 5 version launched on April 17, 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Warren |first=Tom |date=August 20, 2024 |title=Microsoft confirms Indiana Jones is coming to PS5 after its Xbox debut |url=https://www.theverge.com/2024/8/20/24224284/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-ps5-release-date |website=The Verge |language=en-US |access-date=August 21, 2024 |archive-date=September 5, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240905125221/https://www.theverge.com/2024/8/20/24224284/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-ps5-release-date |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Warren |first=Tom |date=March 24, 2025 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle arrives on PS5 in April |url=https://www.theverge.com/news/610817/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-ps5-release-date |website=The Verge |language=en-US |access-date=March 24, 2025 |archive-date=March 25, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250325011552/https://www.theverge.com/news/610817/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-ps5-release-date |url-status=live}}</ref> On the decision to pursue a PlayStation 5 version of the game after initially announcing it as an Xbox console exclusive, [[Microsoft Gaming]] CEO [[Phil Spencer (business executive)|Phil Spencer]] cited the strong reception to prior Xbox multiplatform games ''[[Sea of Thieves]]'', ''[[Pentiment (video game)|Pentiment]]'', ''[[Grounded (video game)|Grounded]]'', and ''[[Hi-Fi Rush]]''. He also described the necessity of providing returns to Microsoft in order to receive support on game development, and the desire to maintain strong interest in their franchises while growing the Xbox ecosystem across console, PC and cloud, calling multiplatform development "a strategy that works for us".<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kerry |first=Ben |date=August 21, 2024 |title=Xbox Boss Phil Spencer Comments On Indiana Jones PS5, And Microsoft's Plan Moving Forward |url=https://www.purexbox.com/news/2024/08/xbox-boss-phil-spencer-comments-on-indiana-jones-ps5-and-microsofts-plan-moving-forward |website=Pure Xbox |language=en-GB |access-date=August 21, 2024 |archive-date=September 4, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240904234704/https://www.purexbox.com/news/2024/08/xbox-boss-phil-spencer-comments-on-indiana-jones-ps5-and-microsofts-plan-moving-forward |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Yin-Poole |first=Wesley |date=August 21, 2024 |title=Xbox Boss Phil Spencer Explains Decision to Launch Indiana Jones and the Great Circle on PS5 |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/xbox-boss-phil-spencer-explains-decision-to-launch-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-on-ps5 |website=IGN |language=en-US |access-date=August 21, 2024}}</ref> A [[Nintendo Switch 2]] version of the game released on May 12, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Life |first=Nintendo |date=August 19, 2025 |title=Indiana Jones And The Great Circle Will Launch On Switch 2 In 2026 |url=https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2025/08/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-will-launch-on-switch-2-in-2026 |access-date=August 19, 2025 |website=Nintendo Life |language=en-GB |archive-date=August 19, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250819210708/https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2025/08/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-will-launch-on-switch-2-in-2026 |url-status=live }}</ref> 

A cosmetics pack inspired by ''[[Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade]]'' (1989) was available as a general pre-order bonus or for pre-loading the game on Xbox Game Pass Ultimate or PC Game Pass. Alongside the standard release, a Premium Edition and Collector's Edition are also distributed. Both editions enabled a three-day [[early access]] period to play the game from December 6, 2024, an extra outfit for Jones inspired by his appearance in ''[[Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom]]'' (1984), and instant access to the game's story expansion ''The Order of Giants'' from release, in addition to a Digital Art Book. The Collector's Edition also comes with a [[SteelBook]] display case, a physical replica of the Allmaker Relic displaying a download code for the digital game, a journal resembling the one belonging to Jones, and an 11-inch globe marking key locations in the game's story, with space for hidden storage.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Middler |first=Jordan |date=August 20, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and The Great Circle's Collector's Edition includes an 11-inch globe |url=https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circles-collectors-edition-includes-an-11-inch-globe/ |website=Video Games Chronicle |language=en-GB |access-date=August 21, 2024 |archive-date=August 21, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240821040921/https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circles-collectors-edition-includes-an-11-inch-globe/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last1=Petite |first1=Steven |last2=Hesse |first2=Brendan |date=August 20, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones And The Great Circle Preorders Are Live – Three Editions, Bonuses, And More Details |url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-preorder-guide/1100-6524003/ |website=GameSpot |language=en-US |access-date=August 21, 2024 |archive-date=August 20, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240820220914/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-preorder-guide/1100-6524003/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

A [[Downloadable content|downloadable]] story expansion titled ''The Order of Giants'' was released on September 4, 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Garst |first1=Aron |title=Indiana Jones DLC The Order Of Giants Coming In September |url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/indiana-jones-dlc-the-order-of-giants-coming-in-september/1100-6532248/ |website=[[GameSpot]] |date=June 8, 2025 |access-date=June 9, 2025 |archive-date=June 9, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250609041558/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/indiana-jones-dlc-the-order-of-giants-coming-in-september/1100-6532248/ |url-status=live }}</ref> The expansion was intended to be a "natural extension" of the main story campaign, and explores the origin of the mysterious Nephilim Order.<ref name="noclip"/> Commenting on the expansion, Torvenius noted that the DLC does not impact the story of the game, though it gives the player additional insights about the game's lore. The team introduced a three-tier system which dynamically adjusted the difficulty of the expansion depending on how far the player had progressed the main campaign.<ref>{{cite web |last=Phillips |first=Tom |date=August 29, 2025 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle Developers Detail Clever System That Increases the DLC's Difficulty Based on How Much of the Base Game You've Played |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-developers-detail-clever-system-that-increases-the-dlcs-difficulty-based-on-how-much-of-the-base-game-youve-played |work=IGN |language=en-US |access-date=October 26, 2025|archive-date=September 28, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250928212953/https://www.ign.com/articles/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-developers-detail-clever-system-that-increases-the-dlcs-difficulty-based-on-how-much-of-the-base-game-youve-played|url-status=live}}</ref> In October 2025, MachineGames added a [[New Game Plus]] mode to the game, as well as an additional ending scene.<ref>{{cite web |last=Campbell |first=Evan |date=October 9, 2025 |title=Indiana Jones And The Great Circle Getting Free Update With New Game Plus |url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-getting-free-update-with-new-game-plus/1100-6535341/ |work=GameSpot |language=en-US |accessdate=October 26, 2025|archive-date=October 11, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251011174915/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-getting-free-update-with-new-game-plus/1100-6535341/|url-status=live}}</ref>

== Reception ==

<!-- This first paragraph is for review aggregators -->''Indiana Jones and the Great Circle'' received "generally favorable" reviews from critics, according to the [[review aggregator]] website [[Metacritic]],<ref name="MCPC"/><ref name="MCXSXS"/><ref name="MCPS5"/> and 93% of critics recommended the game on [[OpenCritic]].<ref name="OC"/>

<!-- This paragraph focuses on gameplay and immersiveness-->
Critics praised the game as "immersive" and noted that the gameplay systems, such as the melee combat, puzzle systems, and first-person view accurately reflected Indiana Jones as seen in the movies.<ref name="Castle"/><ref name="GSpotRev"/> Alex Donaldson of ''[[VG247]]'' wrote that the game successfully represented "all of Indiana Jones as a character—the adventurer, the professor, the ladies' man, the action hero".<ref name="VG247Rev"/> The first-person view in particular was also noted as a differentiator from other action-adventure games such as ''[[Tomb Raider]]'' and ''[[Uncharted]]''.<ref name="Castle"/><ref name="IGNRev"/><ref name="VG247Rev"/> Side quests were commended by Jordan Middler in ''[[Video Games Chronicle]]'' for being as meaningful as the main quests. The puzzle system, and especially the hint system, were applauded,<ref name="GIRev"/><ref name="DestructRev"/><ref name="IGNRev"/> with Middler adding that they were "well-designed" with a hint system that did not shout the answer at the player.<ref name="Middler"/> The stealth system was less roundly liked, however, as several critics found them to be "simplistic".<ref name="IGNRev"/><ref name="PCGRev"/> Ash Parrish of ''[[The Verge]]'' wrote that the game "would've been better as a movie", criticizing its gameplay for being simple and boring.<ref>{{cite web |last=Parriah |first=Ash |date=December 6, 2024 |title=Indiana Jones and the Great Circle would've been better as a movie |url=https://www.theverge.com/2024/12/5/24314376/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-review-bethesda-machinegames-xbox |work=The Verge |language=en-US |access-date=October 26, 2025 |archive-date=December 23, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241223015322/https://www.theverge.com/2024/12/5/24314376/indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-review-bethesda-machinegames-xbox |url-status=live}}</ref> The level design also received acclaim, especially Vatican City.<ref name="Castle"/><ref name="PCGRev"/> Several critics compared the level design to those found in modern ''[[Deus Ex]]'' games and ''[[Dishonored]]'',<ref name="PCGRev"/><ref name="GRadarRev"/> and liked how the game rewarded players for exploring.<ref name="Castle"/><ref name="GSpotRev"/><ref name="PCGRev"/> Its more linear action sequences were also praised for being bombastic and imaginative.<ref name="PCGRev"/><ref name="Castle"/>

<!-- This paragraph focuses on narrative and cutscenes-->
Donaldson called ''The Great Circle'' one of the best licensed games in history,<ref name="VG247Rev"/> and Katharine Castle from ''[[Eurogamer]]'' wrote that the game had a "gripping and memorable global conspiracy plot", and that the game restored the franchise's legacy following disappointments such as ''[[Kingdom of the Crystal Skull]]'' (2008) and ''[[Dial of Destiny]]'' (2023).<ref name="Castle"/> The cutscenes were also praised as being well-directed, with Luke Reilly of ''[[IGN]]'' writing that it conveyed the "slightly slapstick Indiana Jones humour" and remarking that the game "may well be the best Indiana Jones movie".<ref name="IGNRev"/> The game's presentation and tone were also praised as fitting well with the rest of the franchise.<ref name="GSpotRev"/><ref name="GRadarRev"/> Some criticized the pacing, particularly the extended early stay in Vatican City, for interrupting the flow of the story.<ref name="GIRev"/><ref name="DestructRev"/> Rick Lane's review in ''[[The Guardian]]'' praised the story's political message and relevance, writing that it "acutely dissects [[far-right]] ideology as a whole, and actively explores how aspiring [[autocrats]] build their power on the bodies of disaffected young men".<ref name="Lane"/> Critics widely praised Baker and the supporting cast's performances.<ref name="PCGRev"/><ref name="IGNRev"/><ref name="GRadarRev"/><ref name="GIRev"/> Harrison Ford called Baker's performance as "brilliant", and used the game to voice his support for video game performers on [[2024–2025 SAG-AFTRA video game strike|strike in 2025]], protesting the use of artificial intelligence to duplicate their work.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Stuart |first=Keith |date=February 12, 2025 |title=How Harrison Ford brought a strike over video game AI to the world's attention |url=https://www.theguardian.com/games/2025/feb/12/how-harrison-ford-brought-a-strike-over-use-of-ai-in-video-games-to-the-worlds-attention |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077 |access-date=February 24, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Ruiz |first1=Fran |date=February 6, 2025 |title=Harrison Ford isn't bothered by Indiana Jones 5 flopping and thinks Troy Baker's performance in The Great Circle proves AI isn't needed to "steal" his soul |url=https://www.vg247.com/harrison-ford-discusses-indiana-jones-5-flop-and-praises-troy-baker-portrayal-in-the-great-circle |website=VG247 |language=en-GB |access-date=March 11, 2026}}</ref>

== Possible sequels ==
When asked about the possibility of follow-ups to ''Indiana Jones and the Great Circle'', [[Lucasfilm Games]] vice president and general manager Douglas Reilly stated that while they were focusing on making the game and its DLC successes, "I think we're always looking for great stories. And the good news is, there's a lot of space in between the films where we could tell more and more ''Indiana Jones'' stories that I think would be super interesting".<ref>{{Cite web |author=RJ |date=December 18, 2024 |title=Will Indiana Jones and the Great Circle get a sequel? Lucasfilm head gives his answer |url=https://www.retbit.com/2024/12/18/will-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-get-a-sequel-theres-a-lot-of-space-in-between-the-films-where-we-could-tell-more-and-more-stories-lucasfilm-says/ |access-date=December 20, 2024 |website=Retbit |archive-date=December 20, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241220135025/https://www.retbit.com/2024/12/18/will-indiana-jones-and-the-great-circle-get-a-sequel-theres-a-lot-of-space-in-between-the-films-where-we-could-tell-more-and-more-stories-lucasfilm-says/ |url-status=live }}</ref>
